messages.subject: The Hacker Within Meetup, Thursday, March 10th @ 5:10pm: Relational Databases with SQL with Jim Vanderveen
parts:
The next Hacker Within meetup topic is on "Relational Databases with SQL" where Jim Vanderveen, UCD Library Bibliographic Database Coordinator, will give us an introduction. We will also have lightning talks on optimal control with direct collocation, STAN, Clinical Informatics, and ShareLaTeX Continuous Integration.

See:

http://www.thehackerwithin.org/davis/posts/sql

for more info. This will be updated over the next week. Be sure to bring your laptop with the recommended software installed if you want to code along with Jim.

When: Thursday, March 10th @ 5:10pm
Where: Data Science Initiative Classroom in Room 360 of the Shields Library

Format: 1 hr tutorial, several 5 minute lightning talks, hacking session till people leave

General Info: http://www.thehackerwithin.org/davis/

Please spread the word!
